verdict: Dr. Ayaz pairs a Silicon Valley uniform with alien foam footwear while waiting for the projector driver to fix itself.
detailedQuote: The simple black t-shirt and dark denim say 'I posted the syllabus late,' but those chunky futuristic foam runners prove he's living in 2085. It's an understated look that relies entirely on avant-garde footwear to carry the entire lecture's aesthetic.
